name: Merritt Island

known.via: English Wikipedia "Merritt Island AVA" (redirects to "Merritt Island (California)")

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Clarksburg sub-area on an island in the Sacramento River Delta, in Yolo County, six miles south of Sacramento.
